purpose: Bind a state-qualified feature to a single-feature strategy-conditioning trial before later strategy PnL is inspected.

trial_design.comparison: frozen discovery-v1 baseline versus the same frozen strategy conditioned only on the frozen state hypothesis
trial_design.feature_threshold_policy: Any state threshold or bucket mapping must be frozen before conditioned strategy PnL is inspected and may use only market-state evidence, never strategy PnL.
trial_design.entry_exit_policy: Do not modify discovery-v1 entry, exit, horizon, direction, or signal definitions inside the conditioning trial.
trial_design.economics_policy: Use identical realistic fee, spread, slippage, latency and staleness assumptions for baseline and conditioned arms.
trial_design.batch_policy: Use identical independent capture batches for baseline and conditioned arms and treat capture batches as dependence clusters.
trial_design.risk_policy: Preserve stop-based MAE/MFE analysis and do not optimize stop or target parameters from conditioning PnL.
trial_design.transfer_policy: Cross-pair checks must keep the state feature definition unchanged and use a PnL-independent universe; transfer is not untouched OOS validation.
trial_design.secondary_feature_policy: A second feature is outside strategy-conditioning-v1 and requires a separately versioned protocol frozen before later evidence is inspected.

evaluation.promotion_rule: A favorable conditioning result is research evidence only. Candidate freeze, trial accounting, holdout audit, untouched OOS evidence, paper reliability, reconciliation and separate approval remain required before any live consideration.
